scores.note: "$40,000,000. Cash. No name." answers "Buy it." at once.
The three betrayers in one room with the woman they buried; her plan is still unstated.
Edie controlled, Valerie shocked, Dan afraid: readable, but nobody is sympathetic here.
A talky boardroom; the red stick on the table is the turn.
"Hello, Fern." lands on her turn; quieter than episode 1.

fixes: The boardroom needs the table in front of the cast (they stand in front of it).
Necks read too long in close-ups.
End on a physical action (Edie slides the stick to Fern) instead of a look.
